xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1.During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, GMR Estate Management Private Limited (GEMPL), an entity forming part of the promoter group acquired 7,45,56,604 equity shares of the Company from GMR Enterprises Private Limited (GEPL), a promoter of the Company, by way of an inter-se transfer. The said inter se transfer was between qualified persons, i.e. between GEPL (Holding Company) and GEPML (subsidiary of GEPL) and accordingly, exempted under Regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, from the requirement of open offer, after fulfilling the conditions as prescribed in the said regulation. Pursuant to the aforesaid transfer, GEMPL's shareholding in the Company increased to 24.91% with consequential reduction in the shareholding of GEPL to 10.18%.
2.During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, M/s GVL Enterprise Pte Ltd and M/s Yehuda Investment Holdings Limited were incorporated and based on their shareholding structure, have been categorised under the Promoter Group in accordance with Regulation 2(1)(pp) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
3. The shareholding of Synergy Industrials, Metals and Power Holdings Ltd. ("Synergy") in the Company exceeded 10% of the equity share capital of the Company (on fully diluted basis). Accordingly, shareholding of Synergy has been reclassified under the Foreign Direct Investment category.
4.The Company has Corporate Shareholders holding more than 10% shares of the Company i.e. GMR Enterprises Private Limited (GEPL) and GMR Estate Management Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of GEPL. GEPL along with its subsidiaries and affiliates holds approx. 46.28% shares of the Company. The Shareholders of GMR Enterprises Private Limited comprises of Discretionary Trusts with no identified beneficial owners. As such in terms of Companies Act, 2013, all the trustees of such discretionary trusts have been considered as Significant Beneficial Owner.Further the details regarding individual shareholding may be referred to in the shareholding pattern of the Company.
5.Details provided in Table III does not include the shares held by Directors belonging to promoter and promoter group as it has already been disclosed in Table II of Shareholding Pattern.
6.Number of Shares pledged or otherwise encumbered mentioned in Table I and Table II are only for Promoter & Promoter Group.
